item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\nwith open('requests.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: requests=json.load(f)\\nwith open('evidence.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: evidence=json.load(f)\\nwith open('policy.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: policy=json.load(f)\\nwith open('report.json',encoding='utf-8') as f: report=json.load(f)\\nactual=[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]\\nassert report==actual,(report,actual)\\nassert actual==[{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['S1','X1'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['D1'],'unknowns':[]}]\\nexpected_fields={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}\\nassert all(set(x)==expected_fields for x in actual)\\nbase={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}\\ndef test(req,ev,pol,want):\\n    before=copy.deepcopy((req,ev,pol)); got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)\\n    assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,ev,pol)==before\\ntest({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['b','a']},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','b']})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'new','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'supersedes':'old'}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'bad','claim':'other','value':2,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'supersedes':['old']}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'u','claim':'c','value':8,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2},'verified':False}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True},{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'z','claim':'c','value':{'q':[1,2]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}},{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'q':[1,3]},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','z'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'f','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['f'],'unknowns':[]})\\ntest(base,[{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':None,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':2}}],{'required_conditions':['a','b']},{'status':'supported','value':None,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})\\nprint(json.dumps({'report':actual,'checks':'passed'},sort_keys=True))\"]}"}
